subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about basket recovery for your marketplace. With Tanzania making digital payments mandatory across retail and transport from July 2026 and pushing Lipa Namba and QR codes to traders, more checkouts confirm digitally, which makes a clean purchase event easier to bill against. That matters because ecommerce acquisition costs run from 28 to 400 dollars by category, so where a recovered order lands in that band decides your real cost. Peers like Kupatana watch the same shift. Want to compare your recovery cost against that range?
angle: fresh angle: Tanzania July 2026 mandatory digital payments shift (sourced) + ecommerce CPA band 28-400 USD
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce retargeting Tanzania: acknowledges 2nd follow-up and references prior; fresh angle = timely sourced development (Tanzania mandatory digital payments July 2026, Lipa Namba/QR, The Citizen) + real market CPA band 28-400 USD (upcounting 2025); one named peer from brand_candidates (Kupatana, no cross-border giant); no MobUpps figure this stage; exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; no 'X, not Y'; native English.
